text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Morning! How was your day off?

text_block_list.text:
You seem pretty energetic yourself.
Hehe, you
must have got some good rest
too.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Your peppy greeting and perky smile
are raising
my mood even more!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Let's not push ourselves too hard and go
at our
own pace today. And, as always,
let's give it our
all! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик is light on her feet and
looks well
rested.
